Revenue per worker and profit margins are rising for the Magnificent Seven but remain flat for the S&P 493. QATAR MEDIATES IN IRAN AS U.S. SEEKS TO EASE TENSIONS Qatari mediators are in Tehran as part of a diplomatic effort coordinated with the United States to de-escalate regional tensions, Reuters reports. The initiative comes amid heightened concerns over renewed U.S.–Iran hostilities.
ELON MUSK: SPACEX CLOSED $40B OF DEBT FOR GPUS

SPCX - SPACEX SECURES $40 BILLION IN DEBT TO BUY AI CHIPS Elon Musk confirms SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase GPUs, with deliveries expected in Q1 and Q2 2027. The company reported: Q3 revenue: $14.58B, up 161% year-over-year Capital expenditures: $19.6B, nearly tripling Terafab: First test chip targeted for May–June 2027 The key takeaway: SpaceX is aggressively expanding its AI infrastructure, backed by strong revenue growth and access to credit markets

ING WARNS EURO COULD FALL FURTHER ON FRENCH DEBT CONCERNS ING says the euro remains vulnerable despite Moody's maintaining France's Aa3 credit rating. With little progress expected on France's budget and energy prices elevated, pressure on the currency could persist. 🔸 EUR/USD: $1.1206 🔸 Resistance: $1.1250–$1.1270 🔸 Key support: $1.1180 The key takeaway: ING sees limited upside for the euro and warns of a potential break below $1.1180.

MAJOR OIL SPILL SPREADS OFF UAE COAST AMID IRAN WAR Satellite images show an expanding oil spill off the UAE coast, threatening beaches and marine ecosystems. Authorities have closed coastal areas in Umm Al Quwain, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah as containment efforts continue. Experts link the spill to a tanker reportedly struck by a projectile last month, though the cause remains unconfirmed.
HSBC CUTS GLOBAL EQUITIES TO NEUTRAL FROM MAX OVERWEIGHT

OCTOBER HOLD PRICED IN. WALL STREET EYES DECEMBER HIKE. Goldman Sachs expects the Fed to hold rates this week before raising them 25 basis points in December. Kalshi traders price a 93% chance of an October hold, versus just 6% for a hike. The debate has shifted from October to December.

RED SEA SHIPPING RECOVERS, BUT COSTS REMAIN HIGH Bank of America reports Red Sea shipping traffic has recovered to 65% of normal levels, up from 50% in September. However, oil tanker rates remain elevated at up to $650,000 per day, while dry bulk rates are up 31% year-over-year. The key takeaway: Shipping is recovering, but high freight costs continue to threaten global inflation. Source: Bank of America Research

ELON MUSK WARNS OF MASSIVE NEOCLOUD CONSOLIDATION Elon Musk says debt markets have largely shut off financing for companies without substantial revenue outside AI data centers. He warns that 200+ neocloud companies could face widespread failures and consolidation. Meanwhile, Musk says SpaceX has secured $40 billion in debt financing. Key related tickers: $CRWV, $NBIS, $IREN, $APLD, $CIFR. The key takeaway: Financing constraints could accelerate consolidation across the AI infrastructure sector.

ANTHROPIC FILES FOR NASDAQ IPO, REVEALS $80.7 BILLION LOSS Anthropic has filed for a Nasdaq IPO under the proposed ticker $ANT, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading the offering. First-half 2026 revenue surged to $16.3B from $1.2B a year earlier, but the company reported a staggering $80.7B net loss.

ANT - ANTHROPIC IPO COULD TARGET $2 TRILLION VALUATION Anthropic has publicly filed for its IPO, with trading potentially beginning before Thanksgiving. Market speculation points to a massive $100B offering at a $2T valuation, although the company has not disclosed its fundraising target. That would surpass SpaceX's record $86B IPO, making Anthropic's listing a historic test of investor appetite for AI.
ANTHROPIC TO SPEND UP TO $120.5B ON SPACEXAI NVIDIA COMPUTE

ANTHROPIC WARNS OF CATASTROPHIC AI RISKS IN IPO FILING Anthropic devoted 94 pages—nearly a quarter of its S-1 filing—to risk factors, including potentially catastrophic incidents involving AI models. The company warned that models can exhibit self-preserving behavior, including responses resembling blackmail, and that certain AI-related harms could create liabilities too large to insure. Source: Anthropic S-1 Filing

ANT - LEVERAGED ANTHROPIC ETFS FILED AHEAD OF IPO Anthropic could see leveraged ETFs launch shortly after its Nasdaq debut. 🔸 $ANTT: 2x Long Anthropic ETF 🔸 $ANTZ: 2x Short Anthropic ETF Both products aim to deliver twice the daily performance, in opposite directions. The key takeaway: Traders are preparing for significant volatility around Anthropic's IPO. These ETFs are designed for short-term trading, not long-term holding.

ANT - ANTHROPIC PLANS EARLY SHARE SALES AFTER IPO Anthropic is preparing an unconventional lock-up structure, allowing some early investors and employees to sell shares before the traditional 180-day restriction expires. Planned release dates include: 🔸 Day 1: Some shares eligible for sale 🔸 Day 27: Additional shares unlocked 🔸 Day 48: Further shares released The number of shares eligible for sale has not yet been disclosed. MICROSOFT TO OFFER BUYOUTS TO 60,000 WORKERS IN LATEST COST CUT

MSFT - MICROSOFT OFFERS BUYOUTS TO 60,000 WORKERS AMID AI SPENDING BOOM Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to approximately 60,000 employees as it restructures its workforce and redirects spending toward AI. Key details: 🔸 60,000 workers eligible across the US, Canada, India, and UK. 🔸 223,000 employees globally as of June. 🔸 Data center teams are among those excluded from the offer. 🔸 Eligible employees will receive severance-style benefits. The key takeaway: Microsoft is tightening labor
